name: continental-cloud
description: A self-hosted private cloud drive for the Continental ecosystem.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch --enable-source-maps dist/server.js"
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.scan: npm run build && node dist/cli.js scan
scripts.cleanup: npm run build && node dist/cli.js cleanup
